lines.text: On a crisp fall morning, Mark barely touched his water.
It was cold, so he didn't feel thirsty.
By the last mile he had a headache and heavy legs.
Cold air dulls your thirst, but you still sweat and breathe out water.
Carry water where you can reach it,
and sip every fifteen or twenty minutes, thirsty or not.
Mark finished his next hike strong.
Save this before your next cold hike.
